title: apps/web system-status page still reads unauthenticated GET /health (service-wide counts); it must switch to the new tenant-scoped GET /system-status
evidence: apps/web/src/pages/system-status/statusClient.ts still calls apiFetch('/health', apiKey). This unit (apps/api only) adds GET /system-status behind requireAuth returning {db, collections} counted per caller tenant; the web client is a second package and was not edited.
fix_direction: Web unit: point getSystemStatus at '/system-status' (same {db, collections} shape; no watchSilent/watchUnreadable on that route). Separately the Approver decides whether /health (contract health-route.md C1/C2/C5, unauthenticated by design) should keep serving all-tenant counts to anonymous callers or drop the collections field.
notes: Until the web change lands the page still shows all-tenant counts; the API-side fix is complete and tested.
